name: Reallusion Inc.
summary: Reallusion Inc., founded in 1982 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, is a global developer and vendor of 2D and 3D animation software and digital content. The company specializes in crafting innovative tools for real-time cinematic animation, advanced motion capture techniques, and virtual production environments. Its product portfolio includes iClone, a powerful real-time 3D animation software utilized for creating professional animations across various fields such as film, pre-visualization, video games, content development, education, and art. Complementing this is Character Creator, a robust solution that empowers designers to develop, import, and customize realistic or stylized character assets. These characters are designed for compatibility with iClone and other prominent 3D applications like Maya, Blender, Unreal Engine 4, and Unity. Reallusion also provides ActorCore, a comprehensive library offering 3D asset collections, including motion capture data and animated 3D human models for efficient crowd rendering. For 2D animation, the company offers Cartoon Animator software, along with popVideo for general video creation. Further expanding its capabilities, Reallusion features advanced motion capture solutions: the Motion LIVE plug-in for iClone acts as a full-body motion capture platform, integrating data streams from multiple mocap devices to simultaneously animate 3D character faces, hands, and bodies. Similarly, the Motion LIVE 2D plug-in for Cartoon Animator adapts 3D motion capture inputs for 2D animation workflows. Additional enhancements for Character Creator come in the form of plug-ins like Headshot, SkinGen Editor, and Iray render. The company's diverse clientele spans trainers, educators, game developers, and filmmakers worldwide.
